scope: staging-only M4 artifact package and disposable Arch ARM hook check
contents: Nested kernel, loader and Mesa packages, sample boot chain, Omarchy boot source, and offline recovery tools are files under /usr/share/omarchy-m4-research/bundle. No nested package is installed by this package.
build_environment: Local Ubuntu ARM64 VM using makepkg; no dependency resolution for this file-only package
check: A real pacman fresh-install transaction in a disposable Arch ARM overlay with dependency checks disabled installed staging release 3. The existing Asahi hook used a recording updater; it was not invoked, and the fixture's loader file was unchanged. Its outer paths and nested artifact hashes were checked.
limitations: only a fresh staging transaction was checked
no production dependency resolution, future hooks or Gravity-side updater protection
staging does not activate the kernel or prepare a qualified recovery
no M4 hardware or HDMI validation
